h1: H-Banaat Hotel Bangkok — The Closest Hotel to Yanhee You Can Walk To, Brand-New Rooms, MRT Bang O 180 m
intro: If you have an appointment or surgery at Yanhee International Hospital and want to stay somewhere you can simply walk to the hospital — H-Banaat Hotel is the answer. This 3-star hotel opened in 2025 on Soi Charan Sanitwong 92, roughly 100 m from a hospital entrance: a two-minute walk. MRT Bang O (Blue Line) is 180 m in the other direction, making it a genuinely practical base for patients and their families. Rooms are brand new and very clean, with air-con, smart TV, hair dryer, electric kettle and a private bathroom. Prices start from approx. ฿1,100/night, and it holds a score of 9.7 from 37 real guest reviews.

body.html: H-Banaat's single strongest point is a measurable, specific proximity to Yanhee International Hospital. The hospital entrance is roughly 100 m away: you walk out of the hotel, turn once and you're at the OPD in two minutes without hailing a taxi or waiting for a motorbike. For anyone with an early morning surgery slot, or who needs to return daily for wound dressing, that convenience is far bigger in practice than it sounds in a description. Multiple patient reviews use the same phrase: it's "the most convenient hotel for Yanhee."

Rooms draw consistent praise for cleanliness and that genuine brand-new feeling. The hotel opened in 2025 and everything still looks and smells fresh. Every room has air-con, a smart TV, an electric kettle, a hair dryer and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Trip.com's cleanliness score sits at 9.8 out of 10. Room types include an Economy room with a bunk bed (fine for a solo patient in for a short stay), a Superior Twin with two single beds (practical if a relative is staying alongside), and a Deluxe King at 25 m² (the most comfortable choice for a longer recovery).

The other practical win is MRT Bang O (Blue Line) 180 m away, which you can walk to in two or three minutes. That makes it straightforward to travel into the city centre to pick up medication, visit another clinic, or reach a shopping mall without depending on taxis. A 7-Eleven, street food stalls and a small market are also close by, which helps on the food front given the hotel has no restaurant.
"Brand new, very clean, the staff were warm and helpful. It's right next to Yanhee — I just walked out and I was at the hospital. Perfect for a short recovery stay."

The main things to know upfront are the hotel's small scale and its limited hours. There are only 12 rooms and it fills up quickly, especially when Yanhee has a busy surgery schedule. Book several weeks ahead and confirm your reservation directly via LINE (@h-banaat) or by phone. The front desk runs from 08:00 to 22:00 only — if you're arriving after that window, flag it in advance so the team can arrange key handover.

The most common complaint in reviews is not about the rooms — it's about limited dining options in the immediate vicinity. The handful of local restaurants and stalls near the hotel close relatively early, which can leave you short of options for a late evening meal after surgery. The 7-Eleven covers basics, but for a proper hot meal, GrabFood and LINE MAN deliver to the hotel, and this is worth planning for, particularly if you're eating on a post-surgery schedule.

There's no pool, no breakfast and no parking — all standard trade-offs for a small specialist hotel at this price point in this location. Guests who came by car had to find street parking nearby. If you need a pool or a full service restaurant, properties like P-Park Hotel (700 m from Yanhee with a pool and gym) or Beyond Suite (a 4-star option about 700 m away with an indoor pool) are the natural next step up, still a short taxi ride from the hospital.

Overall, H-Banaat Hotel holds a 9.7 out of 10 on Trip.com from 37 real guest reviews and 8.9 on Agoda — exceptional for a 12-room hotel that opened less than a year ago. Prices start from around ฿1,100/night for an Economy room and move up to roughly ฿1,400–฿1,600 for the Deluxe King depending on the date. For Yanhee patients who want to stay as close as possible and be able to walk to the hospital, nothing in the neighbourhood comes closer.

faq.q: How far is H-Banaat Hotel from Yanhee International Hospital?
faq.a: The hotel is on Soi Charan Sanitwong 92, approximately 100 m from a Yanhee Hospital entrance — a 2-minute walk. It's the closest bookable accommodation to the hospital in this area, and is especially useful for early surgery appointments or daily dressing visits.

faq.q: What are H-Banaat Hotel's room types and prices?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿1,100/night for an Economy room (bunk bed). The Superior Twin (two single beds, ideal for a patient and companion) and the Deluxe King (25 m², most comfortable for recovery) run from around ฿1,250 and ฿1,400 respectively, depending on dates. Always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does H-Banaat Hotel have a pool, breakfast and parking?
faq.a: No — there is no pool, no breakfast and no parking. For basics, a 7-Eleven is 150 m away and GrabFood/LINE MAN deliver to the hotel. If you need a pool or parking, P-Park Hotel and Beyond Suite are both around 700 m from Yanhee and offer more facilities.

faq.q: Can I get to H-Banaat Hotel by MRT?
faq.a: Yes, very easily — MRT Bang O (Blue Line) is 180 m from the hotel, a 2–3 minute walk. From Suvarnabhumi, take the Airport Rail Link to Makkasan, then connect onto the Blue Line to Bang O. From Don Mueang, the easiest route is a taxi (around 30 minutes), since a direct train connection isn't straightforward.

faq.q: Who is H-Banaat Hotel best suited to?
faq.a: It's best for Yanhee patients and family members who want the closest possible place to stay and the ability to walk to the hospital — whether for an early surgery slot, a short recovery, or daily appointments. It's less suited to people who need parking, a pool, breakfast or a large room for an extended stay.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book H-Banaat Hotel?
faq.a: With only 12 rooms and consistently high demand from Yanhee patients, book at least 2–4 weeks in advance. After booking online, it's worth confirming your reservation directly with the hotel via LINE (@h-banaat) or by phone, particularly if you have a specific arrival time or special requirements.
